columns.comment: Calendar month of the ER run (quarter-end) as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01' (the month-end snapshot as of 30-Sep-2026). This view is monthly; point-in-time measures grouped by a longer period (quarter, half, fiscal year) return its last month. The latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the ER run (quarter-end), April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: Always true here: this view is monthly, every row is a month-end snapshot or a whole-month total (kept so the same filter works in daily and monthly views).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: The group's lead (relationship) legal entity, e.g. the entity holding the account plan.
columns.name: Lead Client

columns.comment: Group segment (most common segment of its APAC clients): Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Group relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic groups" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for groups headquartered in Japan (Japanese corporate groups) - "Japanese corporates" / "JC" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Group industry sector (most common sector of its APAC clients), e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Group industry subsector (most common subsector of its APAC clients), e.g. Automotive Parts, Shipping.
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: Lead office of the group = coverage office of its lead entity, ISO-2 code (SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand).
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Group lead RM = current primary RM of the group's lead entity (fictional name).
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the group lead RM sits - "RMs in Singapore" means this.
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Worst (highest) internal rating grade 1-10 among the group's rated APAC clients today; null = no rated client.
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: Highest IFRS 9 stage (1-3) among the group's APAC clients today.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when at least one APAC client of the group is on the credit watchlist today.
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating (Low, Medium, High) of the group's lead entity today; null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Worst current early-warning band among the group's APAC clients (Red > Amber > Green); null = none scored.
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Entity-resolution run: ER-20250630, ER-20250930, ER-20251231 (v1), ER-20260331 (first v2 run - the March 2026 resolution), ER-20260630, ER-20260930 (latest).
columns.name: Run

columns.comment: Rule set of the run: v1 (2025 runs) or v2 (from Mar-2026).
columns.name: Rule Version

columns.comment: Attributed (exposure resolved to a client group) or Unattributed (records the run could not attribute).
columns.name: Attribution Status

columns.comment: True when re-resolution in the run changed the group's exposure by more than 20% (gold.dim_threshold ER_EXPOSURE_CHANGE) - "exposures that changed by more than 20% after the resolution".
columns.name: Material Resolution Change

columns.comment: True when re-resolution in the run moved the group across the USD 500m single-borrower attention threshold.
columns.name: Crossed Threshold on Resolution

columns.comment: True when the group's exposure under the run is at or above the USD 500m attention threshold.
columns.name: Above Attention Threshold

columns.comment: Group credit exposure under the run's resolution (drawn lending + trade finance outstanding at the run date), USD; latest run of the selection (point-in-time).
columns.name: Exposure After Resolution USD

columns.comment: The same run-date exposure attributed with the previous run's resolution, USD (null for the first run).
columns.name: Exposure Before Resolution USD

columns.comment: Exposure under the run minus the same exposure under the previous resolution, USD - the effect of ER alone.
columns.name: Resolution Change USD

columns.comment: Resolution change / exposure under the previous resolution (fraction; 0.38 = +38% for Meridian at the Mar-2026 run).
columns.name: Resolution Change %

columns.comment: Group exposure reported by the previous run (its own date and resolution), USD.
columns.name: Exposure Previous Run USD

columns.comment: Change vs the exposure reported at the previous run (resolution plus balance movements; fraction).
columns.name: Change vs Previous Run %

columns.comment: Drawn lending of the attributed obligor records at the run date, USD (latest run of the selection).
columns.name: Lending Drawn USD

columns.comment: Trade finance outstanding of the attributed trade party records at the run date, USD.
columns.name: Trade Outstanding USD

columns.comment: Client groups with attributed exposure under the run (latest run of the selection).
columns.name: Groups

columns.comment: Client groups (and the unattributed bucket) whose exposure changed by more than 20% through re-resolution in the run.
columns.name: Groups With Material Change

columns.comment: Client groups at or above the attention threshold under the run.
columns.name: Groups Above Threshold

columns.comment: Client groups moved across the USD 500m attention threshold by re-resolution in the run (Meridian at ER-20260331).
columns.name: Groups Crossing Threshold

columns.comment: The single-borrower attention threshold (USD 500m, gold.dim_threshold SINGLE_BORROWER_ATTENTION_USD).
columns.name: Attention Threshold USD

comment: Why entity resolution matters: credit exposure of each client group under each quarterly ER run (Jun-2025 .. Sep-2026, USD; drawn lending + trade finance outstanding at the run date) beside the same exposure attributed with the previous run's resolution - the change caused by re-resolution alone (e.g. Meridian Agri Holdings +38% at the March 2026 v2 run, crossing the USD 500m single-borrower attention threshold) - plus the change vs the previous run, groups with a material (> 20%) resolution change and groups above / crossing the threshold. Per-run snapshots: group by Run or filter Month = DATE'2026-03-01' for the March 2026 resolution; unattributed exposure is one row per run with no client group. Grain: one row per ER run per client group, plus one unattributed row per run (gold.fact_group_exposure_by_er_run).
